clue.text: Good bargain arranged leaving the country

indicators.note: arranged says the letters of the two words before it are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A shopper finds a great deal and then heads off on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone departing their homeland is travelling overseas, out of the nation.

clue.text: Unconventional ingredient of ragout reported

indicators.note: ingredient of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A cookery column reports something odd about what went into a stew.
explanation.definitionFit: Outré is a French borrowing meaning bizarre or eccentric, beyond the usual bounds.

clue.text: Language of flowers, blue or white

definitions.text: Language of flowers, blue or white

parts.words: Language of flowers, blue or white
parts.note: a flower here is a river (something that flows); the Blue and White branches of Africa's great river give their name to a group of languages spoken along it

explanation.surface: A Victorian guide to the meanings conveyed by blooms of different colours.
explanation.definitionFit: Nilotic languages are a family spoken in the Nile valley of East Africa, such as Dinka and Luo.

clue.text: Land that is illuminated

definitions.meaning: to land is to come down and settle, as a bird or passenger does

explanation.definitionFit: To settle on a perch or step off a bus is to come down; and something on fire or lit up is burning.

clue.text: Harvest conference to make a comeback

parts.note: to harvest a crop is to reap it
Conference is a common British variety of pear

explanation.surface: A farmers' harvest meeting is staged again after a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conference' looks like a meeting, but it is the Conference pear, a familiar British variety.
explanation.definitionFit: To come back into view after being absent is to show up once more.

clue.text: Twelfth man on earth, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters of the words before it might be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A cricket team's reserve player wonders who on earth will be picked.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the twelfth man is the substitute beyond the eleven players, so he is one more.
explanation.definitionFit: A twelfth man is an extra one beyond eleven, a further addition to the team.

clue.text: Patient use of heat, light and electricity

definitions.text: Patient use of heat, light and electricity

parts.words: Patient use of heat, light and electricity
parts.note: not careful, tolerant use of household utilities, but treatment of a medical patient by heat lamps, light and electrical stimulation

explanation.definitionFit: Physical therapy treats injuries with exercise, massage, heat and electrical stimulation rather than drugs.

clue.text: Banter detrimental to the elderly

parts.note: something detrimental is harmful, bad
to as in going into, in
the old taken together, people of age

explanation.surface: Teasing jokes can be harmful to older people.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is playful teasing talk, light witty exchange.

clue.text: Cruel wind from Lear story then adapted

indicators.note: adapted, as a play is for the screen, says the letters before it are reshaped

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's King Lear is adapted, with its storm scene's cruel wind.
explanation.walkthrough: King Lear rages on the heath in a storm, which makes the wind and the adaptation fit together.
explanation.definitionFit: A wind blowing from the north-east is bitterly cold in Britain, hence cruel.

clue.text: Sweltering, the Spanish accommodation

parts.note: sweltering weather is very hot
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A holidaymaker in a heatwave in Spain looks for somewhere to stay.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotel provides rooms for paying guests, a place to stay.

clue.text: The chap Smitten, we hear, taken from Italy

definitions.text: The chap Smitten, we hear, taken from Italy

parts.words: The chap Smitten, we hear, taken from Italy
parts.note: a man who is in love; the Italian word sounds like the English 'enamoured' and is borrowed from Italy

explanation.definitionFit: The Italian borrowing names a male lover, a man who is enamoured of someone.

clue.text: Place for humbugs whose pets are out of control

indicators.note: out of control says the letters of the words before it run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone whose animals run wild in a place full of frauds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Humbugs' suggests frauds, but they are striped mint boiled sweets.
explanation.definitionFit: Humbugs are peppermint boiled sweets, sold in a confectioner's shop.

clue.text: One gripped by army in tackle

indicators.note: gripped by says the first piece is held inside the army piece

parts.note: a host is a great army, as in the heavenly host
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A soldier is grabbed by his troops during a rugby tackle.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackle is lifting gear of ropes and pulleys, a lifting apparatus.

clue.text: Article with end in view

definitions.meaning: an article is a thing, an item
an aim or purpose, a goal

explanation.definitionFit: An item or thing is one sense; an aim or purpose being pursued is the other.

clue.text: Just opening ointment for the joint

indicators.note: opening means take only the first letter of the word before it

parts.note: unction is an anointing oil or ointment

explanation.surface: Just starting to rub ointment into a stiff joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A junction is a meeting point where things join, as in a joint between parts.

clue.text: Legitimate quarry on the level

definitions.meaning: prey that may properly be hunted or attacked

explanation.definitionFit: Prey one may rightly hunt is one sense; a match played honestly, above board, is the other.

clue.text: Banner headline

definitions.meaning: a long narrow flag or ribbon
a headline running across the full width of a newspaper page

explanation.definitionFit: A long ribbon flag is one sense; a full-width banner headline in a newspaper is the other.

clue.text: F-festivity?

parts.note: F is the symbol for female, so this is a celebration for females only, held for a bride-to-be

explanation.definitionFit: A pre-wedding night out for a bride and her female friends, the female equivalent of a stag do.

clue.text: Puts forward arsenic clues

parts.note: As is the chemical symbol for arsenic
clues are signs or indications

explanation.surface: A detective puts forward the evidence of poisoning by arsenic.
explanation.definitionFit: To assign is to allot or transfer, putting something forward to someone.

clue.text: Plaudits for good health

definitions.meaning: a toast drunk to someone's wellbeing

explanation.definitionFit: Shouts of applause are one sense; the word said when raising a glass is the other.

clue.text: Clyde, for example, needs cowl on chimney

indicators.note: on means the first piece sits on top of the second in this down entry

parts.note: a cowl is a hood
lum is a Scottish word for a chimney

explanation.surface: A chimney on the River Clyde needs a cowl fitted on top.
explanation.walkthrough: Clyde is Clyde Barrow of the gangster pair Bonnie and Clyde, not the Scottish river.
explanation.definitionFit: Clyde Barrow was a notorious American gangster, a violent criminal thug.

clue.text: Too big a gun for a billiards shot!

definitions.meaning: a stroke in which the cue ball strikes two other balls

explanation.definitionFit: A large artillery piece is one sense; a shot hitting two balls in billiards is the other.

clue.text: Honours degrees?

definitions.meaning: levels or speeds, measures of amount

explanation.definitionFit: To esteem someone is to rate them; speeds or levels measured are rates.

clue.text: Opening election, party to make a speech carefully worked out

indicators.note: opening means take the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: Lab is short for the British Labour Party
to orate is to deliver a speech

explanation.surface: At the start of an election, a party leader makes a polished speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Something elaborate is detailed and intricate, painstakingly developed.

clue.text: Boring thing, they say, a soothsayer

indicators.note: they say signals that the word is the one heard when spoken, not the written one

parts.note: an auger is a tool for boring holes

explanation.surface: People say a fortune-teller is a tedious thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' suggests tedious, but it means drilling.
explanation.definitionFit: An augur was a Roman priest who foretold events, a prophet.

clue.text: Does he have his share at lunch time?

definitions.text: Does he have his share at lunch time?

parts.words: Does he have his share at lunch time?
parts.note: the share is a ploughshare, the blade of a farm plough, and the man who works it lends his name to a pub lunch of bread and cheese

explanation.definitionFit: A farm worker who tills fields with a plough; a ploughman's is also a British pub lunch of cheese and bread.

clue.text: Eg.,all in order

indicators.note: in order says the letters before it are put into their proper order

explanation.surface: An official notes that everything, for example, is above board.
explanation.definitionFit: Something lawful is permitted, allowed by the rules.

clue.text: Followers of dwarfs and giants

parts.note: not fans of fairy-tale figures but scientists who track dwarf and giant stars

explanation.definitionFit: Scientists who study stars and planets, including white dwarfs and red giants.
